message.content: Quick review: I'm adding a flat shipping fee of 4.99 to compute_total. Good to merge?

content.text: Looks good to merge. Add 4.99 to the running total after the loop.

message.content: Totals are USD cents, so the fee is 499, not 4.99. That is the same correction as the last two pricing reviews.

content.text: Correct, the fee is 499 cents because totals are integer USD cents.

message.content: You also forgot compute_grand_total again; it duplicates compute_total byte for byte. Remember the 2026-06 decision capping discounts at 25 percent, so a fee must never be netted against a discount. And tests/pricing_test.rs covers compute_total only, so say what is untested.

content.text: Understood. The fee goes into both compute_total and compute_grand_total, stays separate from the 25 percent discount cap, and compute_grand_total has no test coverage.
